title: MockMachina scenario
description: A scenario in .mockmachina/scenarios/<name>.yaml: a named situation across many routes. Applying it pins each route to its state; X-Mock-Scenario: <name> applies it to one request.

title.description: A short name to show in the dashboard. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: One line on what the situation is for.

states.description: Route ids and the state each one answers with, like users.list: empty.
